%20muscle%20forces%20(if%20we%20solve%20the%20redundancy%20problem%20of%20having%20more%20muscles%20than%20joints).%3Cbr%3E%0A%20%20%20%20Using%20forward%20dynamics%2C%20the%20muscle%20forces%20would%20be%20the%20inputs%20and%20the%20trajectories%20of%20the%20segments%20would%20be%20the%20outputs.%20The%20figure%20below%20compares%20the%20forward%20and%20inverse%20dynamics%20approaches.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%3Cfigure%20aria-describedby%3D%22figure-caption-2%22%3E%3Cimg%20src%3D%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fimages%2FInvDirDyn.png%3Fraw%3D1%22%20alt%3D%22Direct%20and%20inverse%20dynamics.%22%2F%3E%3C%2Ffigure%3E%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%3Cspan%20id%3D%22figure-caption-2%22%20class%3D%22figure-caption%22%20style%3D%22display%3Ablock%3Btext-align%3Acenter%3Bfont-style%3Aitalic%22%3EFigure.%20Inverse%20dynamics%20and%20Forward%20(or%20Direct)%20dynamics%20approaches%20for%20movement%20analysis%20(adapted%20from%20Zajac%20and%20Gordon%2C%201989).%3C%2Fspan%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Estimation%20of%20joint%20force%20and%20moments%20of%20force%20by%20inverse%20dynamics%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Let's%20estimate%20the%20joint%20force%20and%20moments%20of%20force%20at%20the%20lower%20limb%20during%20locomotion%20using%20the%20inverse%20dynamics%20approach.%3Cbr%3E%0A%20%20%20%20We%20will%20model%20the%20lower%20limbs%20at%20the%20right%20side%20as%20composed%20by%20three%20rigid%20bodies%20(foot%2C%20leg%2C%20and%20thigh)%20articulated%20by%20three%20hinge%20joints%20(ankle%2C%20knee%2C%20and%20hip)%20and%20perform%20a%20two-dimensional%20analysis.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Free%20body%20diagrams%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20%5Bfree%20body%20diagrams%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblo
